## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add tabs
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `Tabs.gx` | `ui/tabs/Tabs.gx` |
| `TabItem.gx` | `ui/tabs/TabItem.gx` |
| `Tabs.fixtures.go` | `ui/tabs/Tabs.fixtures.go` |
| `TabItem.fixtures.go` | `ui/tabs/TabItem.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/tabs/Tabs.gx"
package tabs

props {
  Sync     string   = ""
  Default  string   = ""
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<div class={gx.Cx("w-full", p.Class)} data-gx-tabs data-sync={p.Sync} data-default={p.Default} {...p.Attrs}>{p.Children}</div>
```

```gx title="ui/tabs/TabItem.gx"
package tabs

props {
  Label    string
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<div class={gx.Cx("", p.Class)} data-gx-tab-item {...p.Attrs}>
  <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="-1" data-gx-tab={p.Label} class="-mb-px border-b-2 border-transparent px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground data-[selected=true]:border-foreground data-[selected=true]:text-foreground">{p.Label}</button>
  <div class="pt-4" data-gx-tab-panel>{p.Children}</div>
</div>
```

```go title="ui/tabs/Tabs.fixtures.go"
package tabs

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var TabsFixtures = gx.Fixtures[TabsProps]{
	"Two": {Children: gx.Frag(

	)},
	"Synced": {Sync: "demo-tabs", Children: gx.Frag(
		TabItem(TabItemProps{Label: "First", Children: gx.Text("First panel.")}),
		TabItem(TabItemProps{Label: "Second", Children: gx.Text("Second panel.")}),
	)},
}
```

```go title="ui/tabs/TabItem.fixtures.go"
package tabs

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var TabItemFixtures = gx.Fixtures[TabItemProps]{
	"Item": {Label: "Account", Children: gx.Text("Panel.")},
}

// TabItemWrap renders the item inside a tab group, as a page uses it.
func TabItemWrap(n gx.Node) gx.Node {
	return Tabs(TabsProps{Children: n})
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--foreground`, `--muted-foreground`, `--border`.

## Usage

```gx
<tabs.Tabs default="Account">
  <tabs.TabItem label="Account">Account settings.</tabs.TabItem>
  <tabs.TabItem label="Password">Password settings.</tabs.TabItem>
</tabs.Tabs>
```

Two tab groups with the same `Sync` key keep one selection and remember it per viewer.

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Put a short label on each tab.
- Use `Sync` when two groups must move together.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not hide primary navigation in tabs.
- Do not use tabs for steps of a process. Use a page or a form.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Enters the tab list at the selected tab. |
| Enter, Space | Selects the focused tab. |
